verdict.rationale: Mem0 is a hosted memory service handling user data, so a training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documented training opt-out, data-usage policy, or no-training commitment. The self-hosting claims ('You own the stack, the data') are a related deployment option, not a control that keeps data out of model training, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
